blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A purported bagman told the Sandiganbayan Third Division on Tuesday that he was present at or took part in suitcase deliveries allegedly containing money to four locations, including the purported residence of former House Speaker Martin Romualdez. Witness Gil Navidad made the revelation while testifying at Romualdez’s bail hearing for plunder stemming from alleged kickbacks worth P7.44 billion delivered by former security personnel of Ako Bicol Rep. Zaldy Co. READ: Video of alleged suitcases in Romualdez’s Forbes home shown in court Navidad was a former Marine who worked as security personnel for Co, who is also a co-accused […]...
